snippet.title: Date Announce | Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
snippet.description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest launches on October 23, 2026 on the Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, and Xbox Series X|S. 

Create your own Warrior Cat, join a Clan and battle your way though four new storylines written exclusively for the game by Erin Hunter, author of the best-selling book series. Forge your destiny, defend your clan and become a true Warrior Cat!
